Brush JavaScript/WebAssembly runtime.
Built from ArthurBrussee/brush compatibility commit 3b80985709e2ec04fd6c8622a40e36473647a8e0.
360GS extension: v0.3c8 source-position holdout, BA/SfM hybrid seeds, sparse bounded browser densification, and adaptive convergence stopping.
Browser plan: 16k/24k/30k initial seeds; 36k/50k/60k caps; refinement approximately every 1600 iterations; growth fraction 5-8%; SH degree 0.
Brush 1.0.0 (2026-08-15) was reviewed but is intentionally not mixed into this controlled c7-to-c8 quality experiment.
wasm-opt disabled in CI because --converge exceeded hosted-runner time limits.
